title: Clean Hands
summary: Start: enter Clean Hands. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Fine Clerk. Do: come within 320 meters of the Fine Clerk. The clerk slides alongside and reads a dirty hold as a fine. The warden patrol hails before the guns. Finish: after the clerk is met, come inside Feedstock's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
